html:
Valabhi is an ancient city on the Saurashtra peninsula of Gujarat, near Bhavnagar, once the capital of the Maitraka kings. On the 800 and 900 maps its name stands for Saurashtra.

Under the Maitrakas, from about 475 to 776, Valabhi was a rich port and a famed seat of learning, with Buddhist monasteries that the pilgrim Yijing compared to Nalanda. Jain monks held a council here in the 5th century and wrote down their canon.

By the time of these maps the Maitrakas had fallen, probably after Arab raids from Sindh. Saurashtra was split among smaller dynasties that owed loyalty to the Gurjara Pratiharas or the Rashtrakutas. The city faded, and today Vallabhipur is a small town.
sum: Valabhi is an ancient city on the Saurashtra peninsula of Gujarat, near Bhavnagar, once the capital of the Maitraka kings. On the 800 and 900 maps its name stands for Saurashtra.
